facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline implication that initialization guarantees resource availability before installing the callback.
facts.value: On each invocation, the callback unconditionally copies the retained reflection matrix into the retained texture object and then calls the common display routine. It has no resource guard or timer. Initialization stores the lookup result and installs this callback even when the texture lookup returns NULL, after issuing a warning; successful texture lookup is therefore an assumed resource invariant, not an enforced installation condition.
